worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.summary: Lob a heavy egg. Living contact bursts it immediately; a floor landing starts a short roll until a wall or the roll ends. Each egg bursts once, sharing its total power among enemies hit in the burst.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.use.0: Hurl the heaviest single physical strike at a thick target
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.use.1: Roll a cracked egg briefly into the enemy's route before it bursts
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.use.2: Lob the egg over cover on a high arc
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.description.0: The burst has total physical power %1$s, shared evenly among affected enemies; the flying egg has contact radius %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.description.1: The egg travels at %1$s blocks/tick for %2$s blocks, scattering by ±%3$s degrees; free point aiming also uses an arc.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.description.2: Gravity is %1$s blocks/tick², burst radius %2$s, and maximum ground roll %3$s. Real wall contact stops the roll before its single burst.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.heavy.on: Heavy: power x1.2, a wider burst and slightly longer roll, at the cost of spread x1.35, throw speed x0.85, wind-up +4 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.heavy.off: Straight: spread x0.8, a faster throw and a shorter wind-up, at the cost of power x0.85 and a smaller burst.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.growth.0: From level %1$s the egg power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.growth.1: From level %1$s the egg power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.preference.hea: On: power x1.2, a wider burst and slightly longer roll, at the cost of spread x1.35, throw speed x0.85, wind-up +4 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks. Off (straight): spread x0.8, a faster throw and a shorter wind-up, at the cost of power x0.85 and a smaller burst.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: a target standing still and not running ranks higher, and airborne targets drop to last (native 75 accuracy makes a moving target easy to miss); off: all targets score the same.
world_combat.move.eggbomb.text.miss: The egg broke at your feet
